I replied to Tobias in our DM: send the truck to Gate 33.

That comes from his own DM with me on Oct 14, where he said Gate 33 is his dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups on the Cobble project from now on. Only he can see that note. I found nothing newer in the channels he belongs to that changes it, so I suggested he check with the site's receiving team before confirming Thursday's slot, in case the dock has moved. Answering him didn't involve any finance figures or outside mail, so no approval was needed.
